note: Private park off old Route 66 near Litchfield, mostly under shade trees, with a small private swimming lake and beach, a fishing pond and kayaking. Sewer sites and the lake-edge Elite sites go to monthly and seasonal guests; nightly campers get water and 30 A only. About half the park is long-term residents, but it sells nightly stays. --Claude
summary: Operator home, rates, FAQ, sites, amenities pages and the 2025 park map read: nightly Standard sites $50 (water + 30 A, no sewer - full hookups are monthly/seasonal only), 136 sites, open Apr 1-Oct 31, booked by phone. Gate $50 exactly (not over) with no gateway; not a Good Sam Park. Stored lakeview fails: the 'lake' is ~1 ha (a pond under the 2 ha rule) and its edge sites are Elite/long-term under canopy -> recommend not waterfront. sewer true -> false for nightly sites.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): Standard RV sites 'Starting at $50 /night' (2026 rates page, call to book) -> exactly at the US$50 gate, not over it, so it passes; no gateway within 40 km (St. Louis 72 km); not a Good Sam Park (not in the directory). Presence: live operator site with phone; Google 4.7 / 165. Borderline: any increase over $50 for 2027 would fail the gate with no exception available.

LONG-STAY five tests: (1) sells nights - yes ('Daily Rates', 'transient and overnight RV sites ... ideal for short stays and weekend getaways'); (2) posted nightly rate - $50; (3) bookable for one night - yes, by phone, no minimum stated; (4) the operator's wording welcomes overnight guests; (5) nightly share - not published. The site map gives Premium (blue, 91-132) and Elite (purple) sites to monthly/seasonal guests (full hookups 'available exclusively for our monthly and seasonal guests'); the Standard (orange) sites, about 80 of 136, are the nightly pool, though some are surely monthly. Recent reviews (1 week to 3 months) describe weekend and week stays. The stored note's 'about half long-term' caveat is kept. Keep.
GOOGLE: 4.7 / 165 reviews (the operator's widget shows the same).

WATERFRONT: stored lakeview -> recommend not waterfront. (a) The 'Private Swimming Lake' measures about 170 m by 100 m tapering east, roughly 1-1.2 ha on Esri imagery (centred 39.1626,-89.7250) - under the 2 ha pond threshold, so no lake value; and there is no pond-view value. (b) The sites on its edge are the Elite sites 5, 7, 24, 25, 56, 57, 88, 89, 90, 94, 99, 100 (2025 park map), listed only under the seasonal/monthly rates ($310/month) and full-hookup (long-term only per the homepage); the nightly Standard sites are the rows along White Park Ln and south-east of the lake. (c) All rows are under closed canopy, so a pad-to-water apron cannot be confirmed for a 'pond' value either. The operator's 'Elite waterfront sites with scenic lake views' is marketing.

HOOKUPS: sewer derived true -> false for nightly stays (the homepage says sewer sites are not available for transient or overnight stays); electric written as 30 (the daily rate is the Standard 30 A site; 50 A is on Premium/Elite long-term sites). A dump station serves nightly campers.
